title: DeLeaker: Dynamic Inference-Time Reweighting for Semantic Leakage Mitigation in Text-to-Image Models
role: training-free, box-free, no-extra-pass attention reweighting against leakage on FLUX, with an ablation locating leakage in image-to-text attention, and SLIM, a human-checked leakage dataset with a tested comparative scorer
enters: cross-attention (image-to-text attention inside FLUX's joint attention); text-to-text and image-to-image matter less
enters_evidence: measurement: ablation on 840 SLIM pair images; removing the own-word boost drops major improvement to 0.54 of full, text-to-text suppression worsens results by 9% to 20%, image-to-image alone gives 11.90% major improvement against 46.07%
changes: pre-softmax scores: other subject's words set to -inf for a subject's pixels, own words multiplied by alpha 1.2, pixel-to-pixel scores between subjects above mean + 2 std set to -inf; masks from image-to-word scores above mean + 0.9 std; blocks 57 to 741 of 1,140 (about steps 1 to 13 of 20)
training: nothing trained; no boxes, masks, LLM or reference image; needs the token indices of each subject in the prompt
model: FLUX.1-dev (20 steps, guidance 3.5) and SANA; never run on a UNet model
similar_subjects: SLIM pairs of visually similar animals, 840 images, automatic 5-way label: major improvement 46.07% and minor 9.76% against 35.60% and 11.07% for an entity-description prompt; human study 67.8% improved
which_pairs: argued, not measured per pair: leakage primarily driven by visual similarity, acute within fine-grained categories; fruit pairs rarely leak but triplets do
when: qualitative: subject masks clean at step 1 (block 50) and blended by step 12 of 20 (block 660) in leaking images; no window experiment
cost: no extra passes (masks from the same pass, scores edited in place); no runtime printed
headline: major leakage improvement on 46.07% of 840 SLIM pair images against 35.60% for the best baseline (entity-description prompt), share of images 0 to 100%, FLUX.1-dev
suggests: (inferred) cross-attention overlap should out-predict CLIP text cosine; compute overlap per step since FLUX masks blend mid-sampling; never use CLIP or BLIP crop scores to score borrowing; DeLeaker ported to SDXL's cross- and self-attention is the cheapest box-free fix to try beside Bounded Attention
